node.statement: Dependency-bearing bridge: depend on node 1.2.1 for the membership premise r_j in C for every j and r in C, and depend on node 1.2.2 for the coefficient premise c_j >= 0, 1-s > 0, and sum_j c_j + (1-s) = 1. These two validated inputs make r_star = sum_j c_j r_j + (1-s)r a finite convex combination of points of C; therefore convexity of C implies r_star in C.
